extracted.subtask_description: A public retraction and explanatory statement by a news organization addressing an erroneous report (here a broadcast/investigative story), summarizing investigation findings, assigning responsibility, apologizing, and describing corrective steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: "Nothing is more important to a news organization than its reputation for accuracy, fairness and responsibility." / "assuring our staff and viewers that we get the story right."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories must be factually accurate; the organization should prioritize accuracy above other considerations and publicly acknowledge when accuracy was not achieved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness
rubrics_metrics.description: "Nothing is more important to a news organization than its reputation for accuracy, fairness and responsibility."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coverage should be balanced and fair to subjects; when fairness is breached, corrective actions (apology/retraction) are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibility (organizational accountability)
rubrics_metrics.description: "CNN alone bears responsibility for both the television reports and for the printed article in the June 15 issue of Time magazine."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The news organization must accept responsibility for reporting errors it controls (including cross-platform publications) rather than deflecting blame.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source vetting and reliability
rubrics_metrics.description: "We acknowledge serious faults in the use of sources who provided NewsStand with the original reports." / original report "came to us from personnel involved in the Tailwind Operation and was supported by individuals who were in a position to know about the operation."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use sources who are demonstrably in a position to know; thoroughly vet and corroborate source claims; avoid over-reliance on unverified or single-source testimony.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of evidence and corroboration
rubrics_metrics.description: "The report concludes that NewsStand's broadcast on Operation Tailwind cannot be supported. There is insufficient evidence that sarin or any other deadly gas was used."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Major allegations (e.g., use of deadly gas, targeting defectors) require sufficient independent evidence and corroboration; if evidence is insufficient, claims must not be presented as established fact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retraction and correction when unsupported
rubrics_metrics.description: "we retract the Tailwind story. We apologize to our viewers and to our colleagues at Time for this mistake."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When reporting is found to be unsupported, the organization should issue a clear retraction, correct the record, and apologize to affected parties and audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent review for contested reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: "CNN commissioned an independent investigation of NewsStand's reporting on Operation Tailwind, led by a highly respected outside media attorney, Floyd Abrams."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When serious doubts arise about reporting, commission an independent outside investigation to assess the reportage and reach impartial conclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robust internal checks and balances / editorial procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: "CNN's system of journalistic checks and balances, which has served CNN exceptionally well in the past, failed in this case." / "We are taking vigorous steps to strengthen our internal procedures to assure that mistakes of this type do not occur in the future."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain and continually strengthen editorial oversight, fact-checking procedures, and other internal controls to prevent erroneous reporting; transparently report procedural reforms when failures occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment of responsibility within staff
rubrics_metrics.description: "The fault lies with the editors, producers and reporters and executives responsible for the report, the program and its contents."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify where editorial and production breakdowns occurred and hold the responsible individuals or teams accountable as part of the corrective process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consideration of harm to subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: "We owe a special apology to the personnel involved in Operation Tailwind, both the soldiers on the ground and the U.S. Air Force pilots and U.S. Marine Corps helicopter pilots who were involved in this action... who 'felt betrayed and hurt by the report.'"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess and acknowledge the real-world impacts of reporting on individuals and groups; when harm occurs, provide direct apologies and, where appropriate, remediation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-platform accuracy and responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: "CNN alone bears responsibility for both the television reports and for the printed article in the June 15 issue of Time magazine."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure that reporting published or broadcast across different platforms or in partnership with other outlets is consistently verified; accept organizational responsibility for errors appearing in any partnered medium.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in public communication of findings and remedies
rubrics_metrics.description: CNN published the full text of the chairman's statement outlining the investigation's conclusion, apologies, and planned procedural changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When retracting or correcting serious reporting errors, provide a detailed public statement that explains findings, assigns responsibility, apologizes, and describes steps to prevent recurrence.
